After a reboot, the device default DPI returns.

Use this value as the new baseline, or restore the app setting?
Lower values make text and icons smaller.
Turn on if apps reload when you fold or unfold. The main screen uses the cover screen value, so text gets a bit larger.
Same DPI on both screens (adjustment off)
If the main screen looks too large, move toward −; if too small, toward +.
Reapplies your DPI after a reboot or when the screen changes.
Past data was saved to the device daily by GOAT.
Connect Shizuku and GOAT will grant usage access automatically.
Charger connections are counted only while Shizuku is connected.
Volume button presses are counted only while Volume Button Rotation is on.
Copied text is shared as a TXT file; photos and files are shared as-is.
Add the tile to share what you copied from any app instantly. See ⋮ → Help for how.
Paste here to share as a TXT file.
Applies scale only to the Home screen app. Other apps aren\'t affected.
Lower numbers look smaller. Changing it briefly restarts the Home screen.
Apps are disabled, not deleted. You can turn them back on anytime.
No built-in apps to clean up
None of the built-in apps GOAT cleans up are installed on this device.
Couldn\'t change it. Check the Shizuku connection
Turn All Disabled Apps Back On
Changes the animation speed when opening and closing apps. Setting 0.5x makes things feel faster.
Reapplies your speed even if you turn off Developer options or reboot.
Far left is off; the middle is the default 1x. 0.5x is the most popular.
Adjust window, transition, and animator scales separately from 0 to 2x.
Take photos silently in silent mode
Removes the forced shutter sound on Korean Galaxy models so it follows your device sound settings.
This setting can only be changed with Shizuku.
Instead of Shizuku, you can run the adb command below once from a PC.
The forced shutter sound is off. Photos are silent in silent and vibrate modes.
The forced shutter sound is on. The camera makes a sound even in silent mode.
This device has no forced shutter sound. The shutter already follows your sound settings.
The current state is checked once Shizuku connects.
Forced shutter sound turned back on
Photographing people without consent may be illegal. Use this only for courtesy.
Keeps rotation locked, and rotates to the current orientation only when you shake the device, then locks again.
Auto-rotate is off and the screen is locked. Shake the device to rotate.
When on, turns off auto-rotate, locks the current orientation, and waits for a shake.
Higher values rotate with gentler shakes. Lower it if the screen rotates by accident.
Shake the device the way you normally would to rotate.
Adjusts the amount and behavior of the water. Doesn\'t affect shake detection.
No shake detected. Shake a bit harder two or three times and try again.
In this state, the screen rotates even without shaking.
Detailed shake detection settings. [Calibrate by Shaking] sets count, speed, and wrist turn all at once.
You must shake back and forth this many times to rotate. Higher values mean fewer accidental rotations.
Higher values need faster shaking; lower values detect slower shakes too.
Your wrist must turn at least this angle while shaking. Ignores car and desk vibrations. 0 skips this check.
Taps on the back or bumps against a surface aren\'t treated as shakes.
Rotates only on large screens, like an unfolded Fold or a tablet.
Hides the rotate button that briefly appears when you turn the device.
Vibrates in rhythm with your shake when the screen rotates. Move the slider to preview.
While on, it\'s shown in the GOAT notification.
Features like display scale need system settings permission. Setup takes a few minutes.
Pick a feature under \'All\' and turn it on.
Features that are off will appear here.
When you rotate the screen so the volume buttons are on top, the right button becomes volume up.
Uses an accessibility service to receive volume key presses only. Never reads screen content.
Turn on if the direction is reversed in landscape. Needed on the Fold main screen and similar.
Doesn\'t change the volume key shutter in the Camera app.
When on, it\'s reapplied after a reboot or update.
The items below are set separately for folded and unfolded.
Lab enabled. You can find it in the features menu.
When you fold the device, your app stays on the top half and a matching control panel appears on the bottom half.
The Fold8 doesn\'t switch to Flex mode when half-folded, so GOAT switches it when you fold to your set angle.
Checks the hinge angle while the screen is on. Returns to normal when you unfold or close it.
Hides the status bar and uses that area for the app. Swipe down from the top edge to show it briefly.
From Android 11, the status bar still appears on some screens, like while typing or in the Settings app.
Flex mode turns on when you fold in portrait into this range.
Drag the handles to set the range. Long-press for fine adjustment.
Turn on Flex mode to test it.
Fold the device slowly. Once in range, the screen splits into top and bottom.
This is the bottom half. When you use an app, the control panel appears here.
Leaving the range returns to normal.
Flex mode only turns on when folded in portrait. Rotate the screen to portrait.
When folded to 50° or less, pauses auto brightness so light from the facing screen doesn\'t raise it.
Your app is on the top half and the control panel on the bottom. Turns off when you leave the range.
Turned on with a flick. Flex mode stays on even when unfolded; flick again to turn it off.
From fully open, fold slightly to 130–160° and open again within 3 s to turn it on. Do it again to turn it off.
By default, only YouTube, Camera, and Gallery use Flex mode. You can also change it from the notification while folded.
Other Fold models support Flex mode natively. Not available on non-folding devices.
Couldn\'t change it. Check permissions and the Shizuku connection.
Wireless connections to keep in Airplane mode
Selected wireless connections stay on when Airplane mode is turned on. Mobile data is always turned off.
Takes effect the next time you turn on Airplane mode.
Hides the icons you select. Some icons can\'t be hidden depending on your One UI version.
Green dot at top right while recording or shooting · Shizuku required
Calculates orientation from the sensors and rotates right away without waiting for the system. Follows the system if the orientation is unclear.
How much things wobble when moving. 0% is rigid; higher is more flexible. Doesn\'t affect speed.
Vibration strength when you tap, toggle, or select. 0% is off, and your device touch vibration setting also applies.
Preview: tap to see it move
Choose the goat style for the app icon and logo. You may need to re-place the Home screen icon.
Color of drops, selection marks, and buttons. Galaxy theme uses one color from your color palette.
How fast the water drop UI moves. Higher is faster; lower is slower.
Clears learned resolution and PPI info and collects it again. Your DPI setting is kept.
Turns off auto apply, clears the apply history, then shows the PC command to revoke permission.
Auto apply stops and the apply history is deleted. To use it again, you\'ll need to grant permission again.
Reset permission? This can\'t be undone.
The currently applied DPI stays as-is.
The app can\'t revoke this permission by itself.
Run the command below on a PC to revoke the permission and open the permission setup screen.
Waiting for permission to be revoked
Returns both screens to the device default DPI and turns off auto apply.
Returns the screen to the device default DPI and turns off auto apply.
Couldn\'t apply. Please let us know via Report a Problem
Screen info reset. Fold and unfold the device
Changed value set as the baseline
Auto apply off and apply history cleared. Revoke the permission from a PC
Same as Samsung\'s \'App screen size\' setting. Changes persist after a reboot.
To change per-app scale, connect the free Shizuku app.
This device doesn\'t support per-app scale. It\'s only on Samsung devices with large screens, like the Fold.
Use [Smaller], [Default], and [Larger] in the notification to change the scale of the app you\'re using.
Sorting by recent use requires \'Usage access\'.
Shizuku\'s \'Start on boot\' is off. Turn it on in Shizuku settings.
Lower numbers look smaller. Changing it restarts this app.
Returns every app you scaled to the default scale.
Turn off Wireless debugging once Shizuku starts
Wireless debugging is only needed to start Shizuku. On some devices, turning it off also stops Shizuku.
On this device, turning off Wireless debugging stops Shizuku, so Wireless debugging was turned back on and this option was turned off.
Sets how many times per second the screen redraws. Higher means smoother scrolling and motion.
Follows device settings. Usually raises the rate only during motion and lowers it when still.
Keeps the max refresh rate even when still, for the smoothest scrolling and touch.
Locks to 60Hz to save battery. Motion is a bit less smooth.
Can\'t be changed on this Android version due to system restrictions.
The refresh rate was locked elsewhere, so GOAT can\'t revert it. Change it in the Settings app
A high refresh rate uses more battery. The system lowers it in power saving mode, at very low brightness, and in some games.
Lab is enabled, so you also get test versions.
Hides Lab and gets only stable versions from now on. Your current version is replaced when the next stable version is released.
Lab hidden. You\'ll get the next stable version onward.
Installing… GOAT will restart when done
Couldn\'t check for a new version
Saves activity logs by date to the Download/GOAT folder. Attach them when reporting a problem.
Turns off Doze, which batches and delays app activity while the screen is off.
Doze is off. After a reboot, it\'s turned off again once Shizuku connects.
Doze is on by default. Notifications may be delayed while the screen is off.
Apps stay awake even with the screen off, so standby battery drain increases a lot.
If only one app\'s notifications are late, set that app\'s battery setting to \'Unrestricted\'.
Notification delays drop, but the battery drains faster on standby. You can turn it back on anytime.
Turns off Game Optimizing Service (GOS), which throttles performance during games. May increase heat.
GOS is off. Game performance isn\'t limited.
GOS is on. Performance may be limited during games.
Long gaming sessions may increase heat and battery drain. Game Launcher and Booster aren\'t affected.
Game performance limits are removed, but heat and battery drain may increase. You can turn it back on anytime.
Easy on the eyes at night
The system recolors apps that don\'t support dark mode to show them dark. Photo colors stay the same.
On. This is a device-wide setting and must be on for Force Dark Mode to apply.
Off. It turns on with Force Dark Mode and goes back when you turn that off.
On. Apps that were open turn dark when you reopen them.
On, but not applied yet because system dark mode is off.
Off. Turning it on also turns on system dark mode.
Status bar text may match the background color, or white squares may appear on Home screen folders.
This happens when the system recolors other apps, so GOAT can\'t fix it. Turn it off if it bothers you.
Force Dark Mode on. Reopen apps to apply
Lowers only the resolution while keeping text and icon sizes. May help game frame rates and battery.
Restricted because the two screens may go out of sync.
Returns to the resolution before GOAT changed it.
Text gets slightly less sharp, and screenshots are saved at the same resolution. If you don\'t confirm after the change, it reverts.
Couldn\'t change it. Check the permission setup
Shizuku isn\'t connected. Start the service in the Shizuku app, then tap again.
No system settings permission. Grant it first in ⋮ → Permission Setup.
Nothing to revert because no settings were changed.
Nothing to revert because no app scales were changed.
Already using the device default value.
Sheet handle. Drag down to close
